systems.country_label: digital national identity card (carte nationale d'identité)
systems.platform: Gemalto (later a Thales subsidiary); electronic and biometric polycarbonate card with a chip, launched August 2016
systems.tiers: applications at police identification posts nationwide; production centralised at Tsinga, Yaoundé

note: An investigation of delays in issuing the national identity card; a birth certificate appears only as a document applicants must supply. An identity system, so no fact.
